title: Fridolin brain.json
description: A brain's manifest, version 1, in the brain's own folder, as docs/BRAINS.md describes it; config.json's brain_dirs[].approved holds the copy you approved. Fields are added without a new version; one renamed, removed or given another meaning comes with one.

version.description: The version of the manifest; absent is 1.

id.description: Stable: history, the sandbox profile and credential files go by it.

disallowed_tools.description: Left out, the brain gets the global list; [] allows every tool.

prompt_file.description: Relative to the brain's folder, and inside it. Default brain-prompt.md.

role.description: "core" for the one brain that may reach the others through its grants; left out for a sub-brain.

grants.description: Only on the core brain: what it may do with each other brain, by that brain's id. The brain must be configured and not the core brain itself.
